title: Mission Law Brings AI Time Tracking to Its Corporate Law Practice with PointOne
summary: The San Francisco corporate law firm, which builds much of its own legal technology in-house, uses PointOne Time across attorneys and business teams. Hours logged are up 76% year over year.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, November 16, 2026** - PointOne, the AI revenue platform for law firms, today announced that Mission Law, a San Francisco founder-focused boutique law firm that serves startups and tech companies, has deployed PointOne Time across its 40-person team. The rollout brings AI time tracking to the firm’s attorneys and to its engineering, product, operations, recruiting, and sales teams, showing how AI time tracking for corporate law firms can cover billable and non-billable work in one place.


[PointOne Time’s automatic time capture](https://pointone.com/product/time) records work as it happens across email, Slack, and documents, then drafts time entries for review. That includes the 0.1-hour tasks attorneys often skip because writing the entry can take as long as the work itself. Entries flow into the firm’s existing billing system through[PointOne’s LeanLaw integration](https://pointone.com/integrations/leanlaw) .


## AI Time Tracking for a Corporate Law Firm’s Hourly and Flat-Fee Work


Mission Law runs with eight in-house engineers and is building billing, invoicing, and payments into its own client app. Timekeeping is the piece the firm chose to buy.


The firm bills both hourly and flat fees, and uses PointOne time data to understand the cost of delivering each flat-fee service. More than half the time it tracks comes from non-billable teams, giving firm leadership a fuller view of where work goes.


Since rolling out PointOne, the firm has seen:


-


**76% more hours logged** year over year


-


**72% more time released within 24 hours** since Q2


> *“PointOne ends up helping capture a lot of the \[work\] that we wouldn’t normally capture,”* said Tony Wang, Founder and Managing Partner, Mission Law.


PointOne works within the systems firms already use, with enterprise-grade security, privacy, and control.


## About Mission Law


Mission Law is a founder-focused corporate law firm based in San Francisco. Its attorneys act as outside corporate and general counsel for mission-driven founders and tech companies from incorporation to exit, on an AI-driven technology stack built by the firm’s own engineering and product teams.


## About PointOne


PointOne is the AI revenue platform for law firms, helping firms streamline timekeeping, billing workflows, and operational intelligence. Its flagship product, PointOne Time, transforms timekeeping from a manual task into a seamless review workflow, automatically generating compliant time entries as work happens and integrating with leading billing and practice management systems. Based in New York City, PointOne is backed by Y Combinator, 8VC, Bessemer Venture Partners, and General Catalyst.
